name: Revise the document
description: Whole-document revision from OpenWriter: slot 1 is the Story tab's Run (picked checklist items as goals), slot 2 the chat column. Run by the drh plugin (POST /api/drh/revise), not run_slot.py — file parts become the system message, the input template the user message (chat history goes between them). Placeholders: {document} (numbered paragraphs, [pN] text), {goals} (picked checklist items, label: question), {instruction} (extra instruction or chat message), {editable} (paragraph ids the model may change), {topic}. The reply must be JSON: { reply, edits: [{ id, text, why }] }; each edit lands in the doc as a pending rewrite.

1.label: Run checklist goals on the doc
